Models in this folder (loaded from this site only when the matching Lumen Convert tool runs)

u2netp.onnx - U2-Net, small "U2-Netp" variant (salient object detection), used by "Remove image background".
  Paper: Qin et al., "U2-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object Detection" (Pattern Recognition, 2020).
  Source: https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net - Apache License 2.0.
  ONNX export as published in the rembg project's model release
  (https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0, u2netp.onnx,
  sha256 309c8469258dda742793dce0ebea8e6dd393174f89934733ecc8b14c76f4ddd8).
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

realesr-general-x4v3.onnx - Real-ESRGAN general "x4v3" compact model (SRVGGNetCompact), used by "AI image upscaler".
  Weights: https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN/releases/download/v0.2.5.0/realesr-general-x4v3.pth
  (sha256 8dc7edb9ac80ccdc30c3a5dca6616509367f05fbc184ad95b731f05bece96292), exported to ONNX (opset 17, dynamic
  height/width) for Lumen Convert and checked against PyTorch (max abs difference 3.6e-6).
  BSD 3-Clause License. Copyright (c) 2021, Xintao Wang. All rights reserved.

ultraface-rfb-320.onnx - Ultra-Light-Fast-Generic-Face-Detector-1MB, RFB-320 variant, used by "Blur faces".
  Source: https://github.com/onnx/models (validated/vision/body_analysis/ultraface/models/version-RFB-320.onnx,
  sha256 34cd7e60aeff28744c657de7a3dc64e872d506741de66987f3426f2b79f88017); original project
  https://github.com/Linzaer/Ultra-Light-Fast-Generic-Face-Detector-1MB.
  For Lumen Convert, initializers that were also listed as graph inputs, and 35 unused initializers
  (batch-norm counters), were removed from the graph; no weights were changed.
  MIT License. Copyright (c) 2019 linzai.
  Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated
  documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation
  the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software, and to
  permit persons to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions: The above copyright
  notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software.
